newsitem.title: UK: Burmah Castrol buys SMC Group in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Burmah Castrol buys SMC Group in Europe.

text.p: British lubricants firm Burmah Castrol Plc said on Monday it bought foundry chemicals business SMC Group in Europe and sold its Columbia Cement unit in the U.S.
Burmah said it would take a one-off, pre-tax loss of about 17 million stg on the sale of Columbia Cement.
Burmah agreed to sell Columbia to U.S. adhesives firm TACC International Corp for 15 million stg as part of its decision to exit the adhesives business.
Burmah also said it had agreed to buy SMC from Chemetall GmbH, a unit of Dynamit Nobel AG, for 23 million stg.
The company said the deal would expand its position in the European coatings and resin binders market. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
